+
+**D12 / E2; exact-build U.** Parameter automation is specific to its A/B state. Switching away disables it, and returning alone does not automatically re-enable it. With the intended state selected, the PARAMETER context Re-Enable Automation command reactivates disabled automation; switching again disables it again. +

Drag into that folder requires original device name, not a unique preset name. A recognized saved default applies when adding the device, including an included instrument sample. +
+**D12 / E2; exact-build U.** Configure Mode plus Save as Default Configuration in title Options/context saves an exposed parameter LIST for an independently supported AU or VST instance. The first save creates Plug-In Configurations with the relevant Audio Units/VSTs folder; each format can have a separate configuration. Parameter VALUES are explicitly not retained by this default.
